description:
Get variant annotations including consequences, allele frequencies, and functional predictions.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table variant — one record = one variant (chromosome, position, reference and alternate allele).
Key: variantId.
Arguments: variant_id accepts ot variant or rsid (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Variants of OT 25.09 (existence only).

schema.description: Pass at least one of: variant_id, position. At most one of: variant_id, position.

variant_id.description: Accepts ot_variant, rsid; resolved to one ot_variant (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
